name: SaaS Blocks Kit
summary: 10 production-ready SaaS landing page sections built with Next.js 15, shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS v4, dark mode by default.
description: A paid kit of 10 landing page blocks for SaaS sites: hero, logo bar, features grid, bento grid, how-it-works, pricing (monthly/annual toggle), testimonials, FAQ accordion, CTA and footer, built with Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui (Accordion, Badge, Switch) on Base UI. Blocks are copied from src/components/blocks/ into a project; the repo doubles as its own demo with a FlowSync landing page at / and a blocks catalog at /blocks.
contains: 10 blocks: hero, logos, features, bento grid, how-it-works, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, CTA, footer
shadcn/ui (New York style) on Base UI
dark theme by default with indigo to violet accent
single-use commercial license, sold on Gumroad
